📺 House of Guinness (2025)

House of Guinness follows the powerful Guinness family during a turbulent period in 19th-century Dublin, Ireland, as they struggle to protect their fortune, reputation, and the brewing empire that made their name famous. Following the death of Sir Benjamin Guinness in 1868, his four adult children—Arthur, Edward, Anne, and Ben—find themselves facing complicated family rivalries, personal ambitions, and the enormous responsibility of carrying on their father’s legacy. As secrets emerge and tensions grow, the siblings must navigate political unrest, forbidden relationships, social expectations, and the dangerous consequences of wealth and power. Starring Anthony Boyle, Louis Partridge, Emily Fairn, and Fionn O’Shea, the series delivers gripping family drama, historical intrigue, betrayal, and emotional conflicts while exploring ambition, loyalty, inheritance, and the sacrifices required to maintain one of Ireland’s most influential dynasties.

🎭 Genre: Historical Drama • Family Drama • Period Drama

⭐ IMDb: 7.4/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 45–55 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creator: Steven Knight

📺 Seasons: 1 • 8 Episodes

📚 Inspired By: The real Guinness brewing dynasty and its family history.

📺 Where to Watch: Netflix in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: House of Guinness is a historical drama television series created by Steven Knight, that focuses on the Guinness family during the 19th century. The series premiered on 25 September 2025 on Netflix. In June 2026, the show was renewed for a second series.
